tldr: 台股週二反彈約 0.9%、大漲 407 點，重返 45,000 與季線，但三大法人仍小幅賣超約 53 億元，靜待輝達財報。
AI 需求續撐半導體主流，台積電資本支出上修至約 600–640 億美元，記憶體與 HBM 為成長最快次產業，台灣穩居全球 AI 供應鏈核心。
金管會政策動作不停，修正保險業財報與不良資產處分規定，並預告明年八項新制，推動壽險業全面接軌 IFRS 17 轉型。
台灣 7 月外銷訂單受 AI 帶動年增 61.9%、景氣續亮紅燈；財政部放寬連續繼承房地持有期間計算，並開放 9 月營所稅暫繳申報。
海外方面，美股收高，靜待輝達週三財報（估營收年增約 95%）、Jackson Hole 年會與通膨數據；加拿大對約 200 億美元美國商品加徵報復性關稅。

items.title_zh: 台股週二大漲 407 點、重返 45,000 與季線
items.title_en: TAIEX rebounds 407 points on Tuesday, reclaiming 45,000 and its quarterly line
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週二（8/25）強勢反彈，上漲約 407 點、漲幅約 0.9%，盤中高點近 45,169 點，收復 45,000 關卡與季線，一舉扭轉週一失守季線的頹勢，成交量約 6,971 億元。反彈由金融與部分電子權值領軍，市場情緒回穩，投資人在輝達（Nvidia）週三美股盤後財報等重大事件前提前布局，帶動指數量增價漲、季線再度轉為支撐。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index bounced back on Tuesday (Aug 25), climbing about 407 points, or roughly 0.9%, with an intraday high near 45,169 as it recaptured both the 45,000 threshold and its quarterly moving average after Monday's slide. Turnover ran near NT$697 billion. The recovery was led by financials and select tech names, with sentiment stabilising as investors positioned ahead of a heavy run of catalysts, most notably Nvidia's quarterly results due after the US close on Wednesday.

items.title_zh: 法人保守賣超、外資轉進金控與面板
items.title_en: Institutions stay cautious net sellers as foreign funds rotate into financials and panels
items.summary_zh: 儘管大盤反彈，三大法人合計仍賣超約 53.36 億元。外資在輝達財報前夕結帳 ETF 與權值股，同時調節力積電與多檔台灣 50 系列 ETF，資金回補金融與面板族群，買超凱基金、富邦金、友達與第一金。此一輪動顯示法人籌碼相對保守、偏防禦與事件導向，即使指數收復季線，資金仍在權值與傳產金融間審慎換手，靜待重大財報與政策事件提供明確方向。
items.summary_en: Despite the index rebound, the three major institutional investors were net sellers of about NT$5.3 billion. Foreign investors took profits on ETFs and index heavyweights ahead of Nvidia's earnings while rotating into financial holdings and flat-panel names, adding to Kaishin Financial, Fubon Financial, AUO and First Financial, and trimming Powerchip and several Taiwan-50 ETFs. The rotation underscored a defensive, event-driven stance even as the broad market recovered its footing.

items.title_zh: 台積電資本支出上修至約 600–640 億美元、AI 需求貫穿全鏈
items.title_en: TSMC lifts capex toward US$60-64 billion as AI demand powers the whole chain
items.summary_zh: 台積電將 2026 年資本支出由原估約 520–560 億美元上調至約 600–640 億美元，並同步將全年美元營收成長率上修至 40% 以上，反映 AI 加速器客戶需求續旺。積極擴產使先進製程與封裝續為結構性主流題材，資本支出向設備、ABF 載板、散熱與伺服器組裝等次族群外溢，帶動台廠 AI 硬體生態系中上游同步受惠，成為支撐台股電子權值中長期動能的核心引擎。
items.summary_en: TSMC has raised its 2026 capital-expenditure plan from roughly US$52-56 billion to about US$60-64 billion and nudged its full-year US-dollar revenue growth guidance above 40%, reflecting still-surging demand from AI accelerator customers. The aggressive build-out keeps advanced process and packaging the structural leadership theme, cascading capex through equipment, substrate, cooling and server-assembly suppliers across Taiwan's AI hardware ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 記憶體與 HBM 領軍、台灣躍升韓國第二大半導體出口市場
items.title_en: Memory and HBM lead the surge as Taiwan climbs to Korea's No.2 chip export market
items.summary_zh: AI 需求牽動亞洲半導體版圖重整，台灣已躍升為南韓第二大晶片出口市場，凸顯台灣串接 AI 晶片製造與系統整合的關鍵地位。記憶體為成長最快次產業，部分區塊月營收年增顯著，主要受惠高頻寬記憶體（HBM）封裝需求激增，帶動上游記憶體與先進封裝供應商受市場高度關注。此結構性趨勢使台廠在全球 AI 供應鏈中的話語權提升，也支撐相關族群評價與接單能見度延續。
items.summary_en: AI-driven demand has reshuffled the regional semiconductor map: Taiwan has risen to become South Korea's second-largest chip export destination, underscoring the island's role in linking AI-chip manufacturing with system integration. Memory has been the fastest-growing sub-sector, with monthly revenue in some segments up sharply year on year on booming high-bandwidth-memory (HBM) packaging demand, keeping upstream memory and advanced-packaging suppliers in focus.

items.title_zh: 金管會修正保險業財報與不良資產處分規定
items.title_en: FSC refines insurance financial-report and non-performing-asset rules
items.summary_zh: 金管會八月持續修法，修正「保險業財務報告編製準則」，優化財報表達與揭露，提升透明度與可比較性，並調整保險業出售不良資產的相關規範。相關調整為保險業接軌 IFRS 17 與新一代清償能力制度鋪路，促使業者提升財報品質、強化資產負債管理紀律。此舉牽動壽險與產險業體質與監理節奏，也讓投資人更易比較各保險公司的財務狀況與經營成果，為後續多項新制上路預作準備。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission continued a run of rule-making in August, amending the preparation standards for insurers' financial reports to optimise presentation and disclosure for greater transparency and comparability, and revising the regulations governing insurers' sale of non-performing assets. The moves form part of the sector's groundwork as it converges toward IFRS 17 and the new solvency regime, nudging insurers toward cleaner reporting and more disciplined balance-sheet management.

items.title_zh: 金管會預告八項新制、壽險業迎全面轉型
items.title_en: FSC flags eight major new systems steering life insurers into a full transformation
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告未來一年將有八項新制陸續上路，合力推動壽險業全面轉型，涵蓋更早的資訊揭露時程，以及與 IFRS 17、新清償制度（TW-ICS）接軌相關的資本與會計調整。部分金控在資本適足申報上獲得過渡性緩衝，讓業者有餘裕調整資產負債結構與商品組合，以因應新的長期制度框架。此波制度變革牽動壽險型金控的資本規劃、投資策略與商品設計，為金融業中長期經營格局帶來結構性影響。
items.summary_en: Regulators have signalled eight major new systems taking effect over the coming year that together push life insurers toward a sweeping transformation, from earlier disclosure timelines to capital and accounting changes tied to the IFRS 17 and TW-ICS convergence. Several holding companies gain transitional relief on capital-adequacy reporting, giving the sector breathing room to adapt asset-liability structures and product mixes to the new long-term framework.

items.title_zh: 八月 ETF 配息潮延續、00878 首破每單位 1 元
items.title_en: August ETF payout wave rolls on as 00878 tops NT$1 per unit for the first time
items.summary_zh: 八月逾 60 檔台股 ETF 公告配息，在財報與總經消息牽動、盤勢震盪之際，吸引偏好息收的投資人進場。國泰永續高股息（00878）最新一期每受益權單位配息升至 1.01 元，較前一季 0.66 元增加約 53%，首度突破 1 元並創掛牌新高。此波配息潮反映散戶與財管客戶在震盪環境下，將資金轉進高股息 ETF 作為偏防禦、重現金流的資產配置選擇，也帶動相關 ETF 規模與受益人數延續成長動能。
items.summary_en: More than 60 Taiwan-listed ETFs declared distributions in August, drawing income-seeking investors as the market swung on earnings and macro headlines. Cathay Sustainability High Dividend (00878) lifted its latest per-unit payout to NT$1.01, up about 53% from the prior NT$0.66 and a record high since listing. The rush reflects a broader rotation by retail and wealth clients into dividend ETFs as a defensive, cash-flow-oriented allocation during choppy conditions.

items.title_zh: 高息四天王年化衝破 17%、投資人須看總報酬
items.title_en: High-yield "four kings" push annualised yields past 17% as investors weigh total return
items.summary_zh: 本月台股 ETF 配息排行中，高股息產品領先，00891、00961、00881、00894 等多檔年化配息率突破 17%，00881 單次配息率近 8.6% 居冠。理財專家提醒，殖利率並非唯一指標，財管客戶應一併比較填息能力、含息總報酬、配息來源、費用與成分股配置，避免出現「領到高配息、資產卻沒增加」的情況。此波高息熱潮牽動存股族與高資產客戶的資產配置與商品選擇，慎選標的與布局節奏更形關鍵。
items.summary_en: In this month's payout rankings, high-dividend products led the pack, with 00891, 00961, 00881 and 00894 among names showing annualised yields breaking 17%, and 00881 topping single-payout yields near 8.6%. Advisers cautioned that yield alone is not enough: wealth clients should compare a fund's ability to fill the dividend gap, total return including dividends, payout sources, fees and holdings to avoid high income without real asset growth.

items.title_zh: 財政部放寬連續繼承房地的房地合一稅持有期間計算
items.title_en: MOF eases house-and-land holding-period rules for successively inherited property
items.summary_zh: 財政部放寬個人出售因連續繼承或受遺贈取得的房屋、土地，其房地合一所得稅「持有期間」的計算規定，允許併計前手（被繼承人）持有期間，使繼承人不致因短期持有而適用較高稅率。此調整減輕跨世代繼承不動產家庭的稅負，也讓高資產族群的傳承與不動產處分規劃更為明確，牽動繼承取得房地的出售時點與稅務評估，實務上可望降低因「視為短期交易」而課重稅的爭議。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance relaxed how the holding period is calculated for individuals selling homes or land acquired through successive inheritance or bequest, allowing the holding periods of prior owners to be counted so heirs are not unfairly pushed into the higher short-term brackets of the consolidated house-and-land income tax. The change eases the tax burden on families that inherit property across generations and clarifies planning for high-net-worth succession.

items.title_zh: 營所稅暫繳 9/1-9/30 申報、e 化服務升級
items.title_en: Corporate provisional income-tax filing runs Sept 1-30 with upgraded e-services
items.summary_zh: 財政部提醒營利事業，115 年度營利事業所得稅暫繳申報期間為 9 月 1 日至 30 日，並推動 e 化繳稅與申報升級服務，簡化報繳流程。稅捐機關同時釐清，個人出售自住房地雖可享課稅所得 400 萬元免稅額，但若出售權利範圍非全部（非 1/1）者，免稅額應按出售的權利範圍比例計算。此舉收緊部分持分不動產處分的稅務認定，牽動企業與個人的報稅時程與稅負規劃，提醒納稅人留意申報期限與自住免稅適用條件。
items.summary_en: The MOF reminded profit-seeking enterprises that the 2026 (year 115) provisional income-tax filing period runs from Sept 1 to 30, rolling out upgraded e-filing and e-payment services to streamline compliance. Tax authorities also clarified that the NT$4 million self-use home exemption under the house-and-land tax is prorated by the taxpayer's ownership share when the property is not wholly owned, tightening how partial-ownership disposals are assessed.

items.title_zh: 台灣 7 月外銷訂單年增 61.9%、遠超預期
items.title_en: Taiwan's July export orders surge 61.9% year on year, blowing past forecasts on AI demand
items.summary_zh: 台灣 7 月外銷訂單約 979 億美元，年增 61.9%，高於市場預期的 54.6%，主因 AI 與半導體需求強勁帶動接單動能。其中來自美國的訂單年增約 88.9%，成為最強引擎。數據顯示 AI 建置浪潮正驅動台灣出口動能，半導體供應鏈續為經濟成長的核心支柱。強勁接單也支撐後續生產、出口與投資動能，並為主計總處與各機構上修全年經濟展望提供基礎，牽動台股電子權值與景氣循環方向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's export orders reached about US$97.9 billion in July, up 61.9% year on year and well above the market's 54.6% forecast, as booming AI and semiconductor demand powered the order book. Orders from the United States jumped roughly 88.9%, emerging as the strongest engine. The data underscore how the AI build-out is driving Taiwan's export momentum, reinforcing the semiconductor supply chain as the core pillar of the island's growth.

items.title_zh: 景氣續亮紅燈、機構接連上修台灣全年經濟成長
items.title_en: Business-cycle signal stays "red" as agencies lift Taiwan's 2026 growth outlook
items.summary_zh: 台灣景氣對策信號綜合判斷續呈代表熱絡的「紅燈」，主要受惠 AI 需求強勁，帶動相關產業銷售動能與加班工時增加；主計總處與多家機構並接連上修全年經濟成長預測。官方與民間普遍將 AI 與半導體出口列為上修主因，惟高速成長也引發市場對景氣過熱風險與央行貨幣政策走向的討論。整體而言，出口與投資動能延續，內需與物價變化及新台幣匯率走勢，將是後續觀察經濟能否維持高檔的關鍵。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's monitoring indicator remained a "red" light — the top of the range — driven by robust AI demand that has boosted related-industry sales and overtime hours, while forecasters continued to raise the island's full-year growth outlook. Officials and private institutions cite AI and semiconductor exports as the core driver behind the upgraded projections, though the fast pace also fuels debate over overheating risks and the central bank's policy path.

items.title_zh: 半導體賣壓沉重、台積電 ADR 跌逾 2%、輝達財報前續黑
items.title_en: Chip stocks slump and TSMC's ADR falls over 2% as Nvidia stays in the red before earnings
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，美股半導體族群全面走弱，費城半導體指數重挫近 3%，輝達（Nvidia）延續跌勢、美光大跌，拖累台積電 ADR 下跌逾 2%。此波賣壓反映市場在輝達備受矚目的季度財報公布前趨於保守，AI 晶片股獲利了結壓力升溫，也讓亞洲科技股承壓，為台股晶片權值族群短線氣氛蒙上觀望陰影，投資人靜待財報結果為 AI 供應鏈提供方向指引。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media reported a broad sell-off in US semiconductor names, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down nearly 3%, Nvidia extending a losing streak and Micron off sharply, dragging TSMC's ADR down more than 2%. The weakness reflected caution ahead of Nvidia's closely watched quarterly results, keeping pressure on Asian tech proxies and setting a wary tone for Taiwan's chip-heavy market.

items.title_zh: 美股靜待輝達財報、通膨數據與 Jackson Hole 年會
items.title_en: Wall Street steadies as investors await Nvidia earnings, inflation data and Jackson Hole
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體整理指出，全球投資人正屏息面對多項重大事件：輝達美股盤後將公布季度財報、美國關鍵通膨數據，以及聯準會（Fed）一年一度的 Jackson Hole 年會，三者將共同左右 AI 相關股票與利率預期的短線方向。油價回落有助紓緩債市擔憂，為風險情緒提供部分支撐，惟貿易政策緊張仍是變數。市場普遍認為，輝達財報與央行政策訊號將是決定後市多空的關鍵指標，牽動全球資金流向與台股連動。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese market coverage highlighted that global investors are bracing for a cluster of catalysts: Nvidia's quarterly results due after the US close, a key US inflation reading and the Federal Reserve's annual Jackson Hole symposium, which together will shape near-term direction for AI-linked equities and rate expectations. Oil's retreat helped ease bond-market worries, lending some support to risk sentiment despite lingering trade-policy tensions.

items.title_zh: 美股週二收高、聚焦輝達財報與 Jackson Hole（2026-08-25）
items.title_en: US stocks close higher on Tuesday ahead of Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole (2026-08-25)
items.summary_zh: 美股週二收高，標普 500 與道瓊各約上漲 0.3%，那斯達克約漲 0.7%，投資人在輝達季度財報、關鍵通膨數據與聯準會 Jackson Hole 年會前提前布局。油價再度下跌，有助紓緩債市擔憂並支撐股市表現，即使貿易緊張情勢仍在背景延燒。三大指數在近期震盪後同步收紅，市場氣氛審慎偏多，靜待重量級財報與央行政策訊號。
items.summary_en: Wall Street ended higher on Tuesday, with the S&P 500 and Dow each adding about 0.3% and the Nasdaq climbing roughly 0.7%, as investors positioned ahead of Nvidia's quarterly results, a key inflation report and the Federal Reserve's Jackson Hole symposium. A fresh decline in oil prices helped ease bond-market worries and supported equities, even as trade tensions simmered in the background.

items.title_zh: 輝達週三美股盤後將公布財報、市場估營收年增約 95%（2026-08-24）
items.title_en: Nvidia set to report Q2 results after Wednesday's close with ~95% revenue growth expected (2026-08-24)
items.summary_zh: 輝達（Nvidia）將於 8 月 26 日美股收盤後公布會計年度第二季財報，華爾街普遍預期營收約 920 億美元，幾乎為去年同期兩倍、年增約 95%，調整後每股盈餘約 2.09 美元，高於去年的 1.05 美元。市場預期成長主要來自資料中心業務，投資人聚焦雲端與 AI 大廠是否持續以強勁步調下單 Blackwell 系統，作為判斷 AI 需求是否延續的關鍵指標。
items.summary_en: Nvidia is due to report fiscal second-quarter earnings after the US market close on Aug 26, with Wall Street's consensus calling for revenue of about US$92 billion — nearly double a year earlier, or roughly 95% growth — and adjusted earnings per share around US$2.09, up from US$1.05. Most of the growth is expected from the data-center segment, with investors watching for evidence that hyperscalers keep ordering Blackwell systems at pace.

items.title_zh: 加拿大反擊、對約 200 億美元美國商品加徵報復性關稅（2026-08-25）
items.title_en: Canada hits back with retaliatory tariffs on about US$20 billion of US goods (2026-08-25)
items.summary_zh: 加拿大週二宣布對約 200 億美元的美國年度進口商品加徵報復性關稅，與美方最新關稅「一對一」對等回擊，並推出協助受影響企業與勞工的方案。此波反制關稅涵蓋約 700 項商品，稅率分為 15%、25% 與 50%，鎖定鋼鐵、乳製品、家電、農業設備、紙漿與紙類及電子產品，將於 9 月 8 日生效。此舉在美國對加拿大進口加徵 50% 關稅生效數日後升高雙邊貿易戰，牽動北美供應鏈與市場情緒。
items.summary_en: Canada announced on Tuesday retaliatory tariffs on roughly US$20 billion of annual US imports, matching Washington's latest duties dollar-for-dollar, and rolled out aid for affected businesses and workers. The counter-tariffs — 15%, 25% and 50% across about 700 products spanning steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper and electronics — take effect on Sept 8, escalating a trade fight after US 50% tariffs on Canadian imports took hold days earlier.

items.title_zh: 那斯達克領漲、科技股回神；Intuit 與 Zoom 盤後公布財報（2026-08-25）
items.title_en: Nasdaq jumps as tech rebounds; Intuit and Zoom report after the bell (2026-08-25)
items.summary_zh: 美股市場報導指出，那斯達克週二表現領先，科技股回神帶動大盤，市場焦點同時轉向盤後企業財報，Intuit（財捷）與 Zoom 等公司將於收盤後公布業績。盤面下個股波動劇烈，凸顯當前市場由財報與個股題材主導的特性。投資人審慎看待本週重頭戲——輝達週三盤後財報，並以其作為判斷 AI 資本支出與科技股後市方向的關鍵依據，短線資金聚焦績優財報族群。
items.summary_en: US market coverage noted the Nasdaq outperformed on Tuesday as technology shares rebounded, while attention turned to after-hours corporate earnings, with Intuit and Zoom among the names due to report following the closing bell. Single-stock moves were sharp beneath the surface, underscoring an earnings-driven, stock-specific market as investors awaited the week's marquee event, Nvidia's results on Wednesday.
